no_tell.q: Which way is the play going?
no_tell.detail: 108 pre-snap rules tested against direction. None survived correction. Right/left splits by formation sit between 40% and 58% — coin flips.

no_tell.q: Can we predict the explosive play?
no_tell.detail: 108 rules tested against gains of 12+ yards. Nothing survived. Explosives are not signalled by anything they show pre-snap.

no_tell.q: Does any look tell us which gap?
no_tell.detail: 57 rules tested against B-gap runs. None survived as a conditional rule — because B gap is simply where almost every run goes, whatever the look.
no_tell.base: 79.6% of tagged runs hit B gap

caveats: Three games, 102 plays. Intervals are wide and one series can move them.
The B-gap concentration is 93% in game 1 but about 63% in games 2 and 3. If those are in date order, they may already be widening their run game.
The breakdown carries no dates or opponent names, so recency could not be verified here — worth confirming these are this season before leaning on them.
Every read comes from the hand-tagged breakdown, not from the video.

verified: Gap tags match their own hole numbering independently: the 3 hole is tagged B gap on 15 of 17 calls, the 4 hole on 14 of 14. Odd holes go left and even holes go right, matching the direction column. The tagging is internally consistent.
Spot-checked on video: clip 43 is tagged 23 G, B gap, left. The film shows the back taking it left behind the pull. Tag confirmed.
Two backs means a run series, not just a run tendency: only 2 of 28 snaps in 20 personnel come from the 90/91/68 pass series.
corrected: The gap tag on pass plays could not be interpreted. A five-step drop keeps the quarterback in the pocket, yet those snaps are tagged E-Alley seven times, so it is neither the launch point nor where the run fake goes. The earlier 'where the passes go' diagram claimed more than the data supports and was removed.

The snap detector is far less accurate than first reported: only 13 of 104 clips land within half a second of the real snap, and 20 land after it. The tendencies here come from the tagged breakdown and are unaffected, but some frames shown as pre-snap are not.
